title: Owner-authorized AI determinations and five Montana project dossiers
summary: The owner removed the human-review prerequisite. Codex recorded 25 backlog decisions and 103 portfolio identity/counting determinations, selected fr-CA and es-419 language conventions, and built five distinct Montana proposal-stage dossiers. Eligible identity inventory is 54 projects and 25 places; it is not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Determinations use retained, version-pinned research and identity inputs; no fresh external-source check is claimed. Original research receipts, source dates and human-return fields remain historical. The five dossiers distinguish proposal funding and estimated schedules from executed agreements, construction, accepted service and observed adoption.
publication_effect: Local implementation and current decision overlays only. Human approval is not required to continue building. No measured series, fabricated reader observations, publishing permission, deployment or launch is created.
